site: Workday (HonorHealth Support Services — honorhealth.wd12.myworkdayjobs.com, Orion Advisor Solutions — orionadvisor.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com)
class: Modern Workday Canvas-style widgets (skills multiselect and searchable inputs without data-automation-id) and button dropdown choices were not populated or committed, stalling applications at required fields
symptom: 1) On Orion Advisor Solutions Application Questions, 3 required single-choice questions ('What Orion value resonates the most with you?', phonetic pronunciation, and AI experience) remained unselected because button choices were not dynamically inspected for options before passing to the AI. 2) On HonorHealth My Experience, 'School or University' stopped on Education 2 with 'The field School or University is required and must have a value', and 'Type to Add Skills' stopped with 'The field Type to Add Skills is required and must have a value.'
root_cause: 1) Workday button dropdowns with 'Select One Required' were not opened to collect live options for the per-question AI, and prompt names ending in 'Required' were not recognized as prompt text. 2) WorkdayAdapter.is_searchable_input returned False for modern Canvas-style inputs (such as input#skills--skills) that omit data-uxi-widget-type='selectinput' and data-automation-id. 3) WorkdayAdapter.select_skills depended on data-automation-id='multiSelectContainer' and data-automation-id='responsiveMonikerPrompt' which are absent in modern Workday, and failed to press Enter to trigger the skills search as required. 4) WorkdayAdapter._school_names used a restrictive regex that missed 'If you cannot find your school in the list, please search other and press enter', so 'Other' was not queried as a fallback candidate when the profile's institution was absent from the site catalogue. 5) WorkdayAdapter._multiselect_selection defaulted to the input element when multiSelectContainer was absent, causing querySelectorAll for items selected summary and pills to query inside an <input> element and always return empty.
why_tests_missed: Previous Workday multiselect and skills tests relied on legacy DOM markers (data-automation-id='multiSelectContainer', data-automation-id='promptOption', data-uxi-widget-type='selectinput') and did not test modern Canvas-style DOM without data-automation attributes.
fix: 1) Added _read_button_choices to PageAgent to open Workday choice buttons and extract live options for AI prompts, and enhanced prompt regex to strip 'required'. 2) Added optional_name_extra rule in answer_engine.py for phonetic name pronunciation. 3) Expanded WorkdayAdapter.is_searchable_input to recognize modern inputs ending in --skills, --school, --fieldOfStudy, and enterkeyhint='search'. 4) Modernized WorkdayAdapter.select_skills and _multiselect_selection to traverse to parent container divs, query role='listbox' / role='option', press Enter after typing search terms, and extract selections from items selected summaries. 5) Broadened WorkdayAdapter._school_names fallback regex to recognize 'cannot find ... search other'.
prevention: Ensure Workday adapters support modern Canvas-style DOM structures that lack legacy data-automation-id attributes by using role and class-based container traversal, and always verify that searchable multiselects trigger searches with Enter when enterkeyhint='search' is present.
